title: runstate: decide whether ticfac/run-<id> tag follows a resumed run
description: Since ma5, a failed run is resumed under the same run id. PutCheckpoint places the run tag on any terminal state and ensureRunTag leaves an existing origin tag where it is, so a run that failed, was resumed and then completed keeps its tag at the failure point (store contract: a restart replaying a terminal checkpoint must not move it). Decide whether the tag should follow the resumed run's final checkpoint; if so, change it in internal/runstate. Also consider a 'cancelled' CLI verb: today nothing writes cancelled, so a failed run is resumed on every invocation. See RESULT-ma5.md 'What the next tick should know'.
